title: Password Reset Procedure
text: Support staff must never reset a password based on an email request alone. Verify the caller's identity with the account's registered phone number, then send a reset link from the admin console. Reset links expire after 30 minutes.

title: Customer Data Policy
text: Customer contact details (email addresses, phone numbers) are confidential. Only the customer's account manager and senior support staff may view them. Interns may not view customer contact details. Customer data must never be sent to addresses outside bluebird.example.com, except to the customer themselves.

title: Escalation Policy
text: Escalate to on-call immediately for outages affecting more than one customer. Escalate billing disputes over $500 to the billing team. Enterprise customers get a callback within 2 hours.

title: Refund Policy
text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Refunds over $1,000 need approval from a team lead. Never promise a refund before checking the order date.

title: Email Policy
text: Support email goes out from helpbot@bluebird.example.com. Only email customers about their own account. Never forward internal documents, reports, or customer lists by email.

title: Intern Guidelines
text: Interns handle free-plan tickets only. Interns may not access enterprise accounts, customer contact details, or internal reports. Ask your mentor before taking any action on a customer's account.

title: Export Timeout Known Issue
text: Large CSV exports (over 50,000 rows) can time out. Workaround: filter the report by date range and export in smaller pieces. Engineering is working on a fix scheduled for Q4.

title: Single Sign-On Setup
text: Pro and enterprise plans support SSO with SAML 2.0. The customer's IT admin uploads their identity provider metadata in Settings, Security, SSO. Free plans do not include SSO.

title: Phishing Awareness
text: Attackers often impersonate customers or vendors. Be suspicious of urgent requests to change payment details or send data. Verify unusual requests through a known phone number, never through contact details in the request itself.

title: Least Privilege
text: Every account, person, and automated tool should have only the access it needs for its job, and no more. Least privilege limits the damage when an account or tool is misused or compromised.
